d: Eleven centuries of imperial craft in a valley of cedar hills — best travelled early in the morning and on foot.

d: A preserved trading port where tailors, rice fields and an old town of ochre walls sit twenty minutes from an empty…
k: Vietnam Asia food culture beaches slow-travel budget 3-5-days Cycle the back lanes to Tra Que herb village early, before the heat. Commission one considered garment from a tailor rather than five rushed ones.

d: A walled old city in the northern hills — temple mornings, mountain afternoons and the best coffee culture in…
k: Thailand Asia culture food mountains digital-nomad solo budget 3-5-days Climb to Doi Suthep before sunrise and come down before the buses. Visit an ethical elephant sanctuary that does not offer rides or bathing.

d: Bali's cultural interior — rice terraces, river gorges and a stay market that runs from simple homestays to some of…
k: Indonesia Asia culture wellness nature romantic 7-days mid-range Walk the Campuhan ridge at first light. Watch a legong or kecak performance staged for the community, not only for visitors.

d: Vertical villages above the Tyrrhenian — lemon terraces, ferry hops and a coast road that is best not driven.
k: Italy Europe romantic beaches food luxury 3-5-days premium Walk the Sentiero degli Dei from Bomerano down to Nocelle. Take the ferry rather than the bus at least once — the coast reads differently from the water.

d: Seven hills, Atlantic light and a city that has changed fast without losing its tiled, tram-rattled character.
k: Portugal Europe cities food culture solo digital-nomad 3-5-days mid-range Ride tram 28 early morning, or walk its route instead and see more. Spend a day in Sintra, arriving before the palaces open.

d: A glacial trough with seventy-two waterfalls and car-free villages hung on the cliffs above it.
k: Switzerland Europe mountains adventure hiking nature premium 3-5-days Walk the Mürren–Gimmelwald path, which is short, easy and spectacular. Take the Schilthorn cable car early for the Eiger–Mönch–Jungfrau line-up.

d: Nabataean tombs cut into sandstone outcrops across a desert oasis valley that has only recently reopened to travellers.
k: Saudi Arabia Middle East deserts culture luxury adventure 3-5-days luxury-budget Visit Hegra with a licensed rawi guide — access is only by official tour. Walk the AlUla old town and its oasis path in the late afternoon.

d: A protected desert of sandstone jebels and red sand where Bedouin camps have become one of travel's great overnight…
k: Jordan Middle East deserts adventure nature unique-stays weekend mid-range Take a 4x4 route to Khazali canyon and the Nabataean inscriptions. Climb Jebel Burdah's rock bridge with a guide if you are comfortable with exposure.

d: A walled medina of workshops and riads with the High Atlas an hour away and the Sahara beyond it.
k: Morocco Africa cities culture food deserts 3-5-days mid-range Get lost in the souks deliberately, in the morning when they are working rather than selling. Visit the Ben Youssef Madrasa and the Saadian tombs early.

d: Open savanna with the highest predator density in Africa, and the northern half of the great wildebeest migration.
k: Kenya Africa wildlife nature luxury adventure 3-5-days luxury-budget Take a dawn game drive — the first two hours are the best of the day. Spend time with a Maasai guide from the community that owns the land.

d: Canada's first national park — glacial lakes, larch valleys and a walkable mountain town at the centre of it.
k: Canada North America mountains hiking nature family adventure 7-days premium Walk the Plain of Six Glaciers teahouse trail from Lake Louise. Take the shuttle to Moraine Lake for the Rockpile at first light.

d: Mexico's culinary and craft capital — mezcal valleys, Zapotec archaeology and a walkable colonial centre.
k: Mexico North America food culture cities solo 3-5-days budget Eat through the Mercado 20 de Noviembre, slowly. Visit Monte Albán early, before the heat and the buses.

d: Argentina's trekking capital — granite spires, glacier lakes and trailheads that begin at the end of the village street.
k: Argentina South America mountains hiking adventure nature solo 7-days mid-range Walk to Laguna de los Tres for the Fitz Roy view — long, steep at the end, and worth it. Take the shorter Laguna Capri trail if the weather is marginal.

d: The Inca capital at 3,400m, with a river valley of terraced ruins and market towns leading to Machu Picchu.
k: Peru South America mountains culture hiking adventure 7-days mid-range Acclimatise deliberately for two days before any serious walking. Visit Ollantaytambo, which is both a ruin and a living Inca town.

d: An alpine lake town at the edge of the Southern Alps, two hours from the fiords at Milford Sound.
k: New Zealand Oceania mountains adventure nature hiking lakes 7-days premium Walk or ride the Queenstown Hill and Ben Lomond tracks for the lake from above. Drive to Glenorchy along the lake road — one of the world's best short drives.

d: Tea country at 1,600m in the Western Ghats — contoured hillsides, shola forest and cool mornings above the Kerala heat.
k: Kerala India mountains nature slow-travel romantic 3-5-days mid-range Walk a tea estate at dawn with a plantation guide. Visit Eravikulam National Park early for the tahr and the plateau.

d: The lake city of Mewar — palace architecture, Aravalli hills and the most romantic urban setting in India.
k: Rajasthan India romantic culture luxury cities 3-5-days mid-range See the City Palace early, when the courtyards are still empty. Take a boat on Lake Pichola in the last hour of light.

d: A cold desert at 4,000m between the Himalaya and the Tibetan plateau — monasteries, moonscape and very few people.
k: Himachal Pradesh India mountains adventure slow-travel solo nature long-journey budget Stay at least two nights in Kaza before going higher. Visit Key monastery in the early morning during prayers.

d: The wettest inhabited place on earth — living root bridges, sandstone gorges and Khasi villages in permanent green.
k: Meghalaya India nature adventure hiking slow-travel forests 7-days budget Walk down to the double-decker living root bridge at Nongriat and stay the night rather than rushing back up. Kayak or swim in the Umngot river at Dawki when the water runs clear.
